<style>

/* página vira coluna vertical */
body {
  min-height: 100vh;

/* conteúdo principal ocupa resto da tela */
main {
  flex: 1;

  flex: 1;

  width: 100%;

<div class="tally-wrapper">
<iframe
 data-tally-src="https://tally.so/embed/44xXOX?alignLeft=1&hideTitle=1&transparentBackground=1"
 loading="lazy"
 title="Application - ICA Political Communication Summer School 2026">
</iframe>
</div>

<script>
var d=document,w="https://tally.so/widgets/embed.js",
v=function(){
 "undefined"!=typeof Tally?Tally.loadEmbeds():
 d.querySelectorAll("iframe[data-tally-src]:not([src])")
 .forEach((function(e){e.src=e.dataset.tallySrc}))
};
if("undefined"!=typeof Tally)v();
else if(d.querySelector('script[src="'+w+'"]')==null){
 var s=d.createElement("script");
 s.src=w;s.onload=v;s.onerror=v;d.body.appendChild(s);
}
</script>
